harness_limits: docs/harness.md (100 tool calls, 60 min per run)

design.rule: 9.3: K = 30 if all 10 sectors have their three templates admitted (first by creation order per mechanism); min_m k_m < 10 -> resource mode, --exploratory

sensitivity.command: twinguard_analysis.py <input without these sectors> --replicates S --templates K --exploratory (same seed and bootstrap as the primary)
sensitivity.rule: D9 addendum: exploratory re-run of the frozen analysis without the sectors of templates admitted through an adjudicated auditor false positive; reported next to the primary result, never instead of it

truncation: 7.4: a run not started by the deadline gets an infra_failed row (close-out); any scheduled block not complete -> --exploratory, with K scheduled, K evaluable per contrast and the excluded blocks reported (runner/merge.py)

S_decision.justification: S = 2 by the protocol 9.3 rule with the D8 definitions: t_a = 46.06 s per run amortized (re-pilot, D11), budget 17.08 L4x4 GPU hours, rule T <= 0.6 x budget = 10.25 h; T(S=4) = 18.42 h and T(S=3) = 13.82 h do not fit, T(S=2) = 9.21 h fits. The re-pilot after the single 9.2 recalibration (D9) failed the difficulty gates again (pooled W = 0/72); by protocol the confirmatory proceeds and the floor is declared as a limitation (D11). Exploratory plan D12 is recorded in the frozen commit. Author approval: Manuel, 2026-11-09.
